warn.no_control: No flight computer — you won't be able to steer!
warn.twr_low: Too heavy to lift off! TWR = {twr}

warn.engine_attach: Engines go directly under a tank or a separator
warn.nose_top: The nose cone goes only on top
warn.nose_side: The fairing can only sit on the tip
warn.side_boosters_only: Only tanks, engines, fins and parachutes strap on the side

flight.hint_keys: Space engine · W/S throttle · A/D tilt · Q stage · C parachute · P pause · [ ] warp · R restart · Esc menu
flight.hint_keys_touch: Bottom buttons: tilt · throttle · engine · stage · parachute
fail.crashed: The rocket crashed. It happens — try again!
fail.fell_back: You ran out of fuel at {h}. Your rocket needs more Δv: add a tank or use a lighter engine.
fail.timeout: Time ran out! Try a different flight plan.
fail.low_dv: Not high enough: max {h}, need 70 km. Add Δv — more tanks or another stage!
fail.no_cutoff: You reached space but fell back with the engine still on. Switch it OFF (Space) once you pass 70 km!
fail.explore: The walk is over — next time we'll collect more!
fact.m1: In 1926 Robert Goddard launched the first liquid-fuel rocket — it climbed only 12.5 metres!
fact.m2: Space officially begins at the Kármán line — 100 km. In our scaled game the atmosphere ends at 70 km (1:10 scale).
fact.moon: Apollo astronauts brought 382 kg of Moon rock home! The Artemis missions will hunt for ice at the Moon's south pole.
hint.m1: Thrust must beat weight — watch the TWR in the builder!
hint.m1b: Want 3 stars? A parachute helps you land softly.
hint.m2: The engine burns fuel fighting the air — throttle down (S) low down, or tilt once you're high.
hint.explore.1: Look for glowing rings — samples hide there!
hint.explore.2: The radio scout looks toward the nearest sample!
hint.explore.3: Walk up to a sample and press {act} — time to drill!
fact.purple_crystal: Crystals grow where lava cooled long ago.
fact.iron_ore: Lunar soil is rich in iron — we could build parts right on the Moon!
fact.ice_cube_bug: Moon ice hides in crater shadows — it can become water and fuel.
fact.magma_rock: This rock was born inside a volcano long ago.
fact.gold_nugget: Gold arrives on planets inside asteroids!
menu.sound_device: Sound is off on this device
toast.save_reset: The save was corrupted — starting fresh
lab.title: Sample collection
mission.mars.title: Mars Expedition
mission.mars.brief: Explore Mars: drill hematite, an ancient mudstone and buried ice, then call home!
flight.tip_start: Press Space (or “Engine ON”) to light the engine!
flight.tip_stage: This stage is empty — press Q (or “Stage”) to drop it!
flight.tip_cutoff: You're in space! Switch the engine off now — Space.
flight.tip_tilt: Tilt a little with D to fly further on the same fuel.
flight.tip_chute: Falling fast — open the parachute with C!
flight.tip_no_control: No flight computer on board — the rocket can't steer.
hint.m2b: Build two stages with a separator, and press Q when the first one runs dry.
hint.moon.ice: Ice hides in the dark of the craters. Artemis astronauts will look for it too!
hint.mars.mudstone: Mudstone formed at the bottom of an old lake — it might keep traces of ancient life!
hint.mars.dust: Martian dust is red because it is full of rust — iron oxide!
fact.mars: NASA's Perseverance rover is filling sample tubes in Jezero Crater, an old lake bed, for a future trip back to Earth.
explore.return: All set! Go back to the lander and beam the data home.
explore.arrive.moon: Welcome to the Moon! Gold rings mark the samples our tasks need.
explore.arrive.mars: Welcome to Mars! Gold rings mark the samples our tasks need. Mind the dust!
fact.mars_hematite: The Opportunity rover found tiny iron balls like these. They formed in water long ago!
fact.mars_mudstone: Mudstone is hardened lake mud. Perseverance drills rocks like it to look for signs of ancient life.
fact.mars_ice: In 2008 the Phoenix lander scraped the soil and found water ice just under the surface.
fact.mars_basalt: Basalt is cooled lava. Mars has Olympus Mons, the biggest volcano in the Solar System!
fact.mars_salt: Salt is left behind when water dries up — a clue that Mars once had lakes and seas.
presets.title: Ready-made rockets
presets.subtitle: Tap a rocket to load it. The stars show what it earns with the simplest flight: engine on, straight up, drop a stage when it runs dry, engine off above 70 km.
presets.locked: Uses parts this mission doesn't allow
preset.basic.name: Basic rocket
preset.basic.desc: The classic: a medium tank and a Spark engine.
preset.basic.plan: Engine on (Space) and fly straight up to 10 km.
preset.hopper.name: Sky Hopper
preset.hopper.desc: Fins and a parachute, still under 2 tonnes for First Launch's second star.
preset.hopper.plan: Engine on (Space), fly straight up. Parachute (C) on the way down.
preset.arrow.name: Space Arrow
preset.arrow.desc: Two stages: a Bull lifts three big tanks, then a Whisper finishes the climb in thin air.
preset.arrow.plan: Engine on (Space) · Stage (Q) when stage 1 runs dry · Engine off (Space) above 70 km.
preset.triple.name: Triple Booster
preset.triple.desc: Two strap-on boosters burn with the core, so the top stage reaches space almost full.
preset.triple.plan: Engine on (Space) · Stage (Q) when the boosters run dry · Engine off (Space) above 70 km.
preset.crew.name: Crew Capsule
preset.crew.desc: An astronaut's pod and a parachute on top of a big two-stage rocket.
preset.crew.plan: Engine on (Space) · Stage (Q) when stage 1 runs dry · Engine off above 70 km · Parachute (C) to come home.
preset.escape.name: Star Chaser
preset.escape.desc: Three stages and strap-on tanks: enough Δv to leave Earth for good. Try it in Sandbox!
preset.escape.plan: Engine on (Space) · Stage (Q) each time a stage runs dry · keep burning until Apoapsis says “escaping”!
hint.explore.rover: The rover is faster than walking: press {act} next to it!
explore.rover_ready: The rover is ready! Walk up to it and press {act} to drive.
explore.rover_fact.moon: Apollo 15–17 crews drove a Moon buggy at up to 18 km/h!
explore.rover_fact.mars: Perseverance tops out at 0.15 km/h. Ours is a bit quicker!
explore.prompt_drill_rover: {act} — drill the {sample} with the rover arm!
explore.rover_keys: E / F: get out · H: horn
explore.rover_keys_touch: Stick to drive · button to get out
